name: Poly(ethylene terephthalate) (PET)
description: Thermoplastic semi-crystalline polyester synthesized from terephthalic acid and ethylene glycol. Extensively used in packaging, beverage bottles, and synthetic fibers.

properties.ester_bond_cleavage_susceptibility: Moderate to high at amorphous domains; low at dense crystalline lamellae
properties.environmental_persistence_years: Hundreds of years in ambient landfills and marine ecosystems

name: Poly(ethylene 2,5-furandicarboxylate) (PEF)
description: Bio-based aromatic polyester synthesized from 2,5-furandicarboxylic acid and ethylene glycol. Potential sustainable alternative to petroleum-derived PET with higher gas barrier performance.

properties.ester_bond_cleavage_susceptibility: Degradable by engineered PETase mutants (Austin et al. 2018)

name: Poly(lactic acid) (PLA)
description: Aliphatic bio-polyester derived from fermented plant starch. Biodegradable under industrial composting conditions (elevated temperature >58°C).

properties.ester_bond_cleavage_susceptibility: Degradable by serine proteases (Proteinase K) and lipases, limited PETase affinity

name: Ideonella sakaiensis PETase (IsPETase)
description: Wild-type alpha/beta-hydrolase fold esterase secreted by Ideonella sakaiensis 201-F6. Specifically cleaves ester bonds in amorphous poly(ethylene terephthalate).

properties.product_inhibition: Inhibited by accumulation of MHET and BHET

name: FAST-PETase (Machine Learning Engineered)
description: Functional, Active, Stable, and Tolerant PETase developed through structure-based ML (MutCompute). Incorporates 5 point mutations (N233K/R224Q/S121E/D186H/R280A).

properties.substrate_preference: Post-consumer PET bottles, thermoformed trays, polyester fibers

name: LCC-ICCG Cutinase (Thermostabilized)
description: Engineered leaf-branch compost cutinase variant (F243I/D238C/S283C/Y127G) featuring an engineered disulfide bond for elevated operating temperatures.

name: Ideonella sakaiensis MHETase
description: Periplasmic or cell-associated esterase that specifically hydrolyzes mono-(2-hydroxyethyl) terephthalate (MHET) into monomeric terephthalic acid and ethylene glycol.

properties.substrate_preference: MHET (no detectable activity on polymeric PET)
properties.synergistic_role: Relieves MHET accumulation inhibition on PETase

name: Ideonella sakaiensis 201-F6
description: Gram-negative, aerobic, rod-shaped betaproteobacterium isolated from sediment samples near a plastic recycling facility in Sakai, Japan.

properties.secretome: Secretes IsPETase extracellularly; possesses MHETase and downstream TPA assimilation pathways
properties.catabolism: Converts TPA to protocatechuic acid via PCA 4,5-cleavage pathway

name: Escherichia coli BL21(DE3) Expression Host
description: Standard recombinant bacterial production chassis widely used for high-yield heterologous expression and secretion of recombinant PETases.

properties.respiration: Facultative anaerobic (aerobic required for high-density culture)
properties.chassis_notes: Requires cell lysis or signal peptide targeting for enzyme harvest

name: Sodium Phosphate Buffer (50 mM, pH 7.0)
description: Standard biological buffer maintaining neutral pH during initial hydrolytic cleavage. Counters early local proton release from carboxylic acid generation.

properties.role: Stabilizes active-site ionization states of mesophilic hydrolases

name: Tris-HCl Buffer (50 mM, pH 8.0)
description: Amine-based buffer widely used for alkaline-active enzymes, cutinases, and MHETase characterization.

properties.temperature_coefficient: pH shifts ~0.03 pH units per °C increase
properties.role: Alkaline buffer suitable for FAST-PETase and LCC-ICCG assays

name: Calcium Chloride (CaCl2, 1-10 mM)
description: Divalent cation cofactor known to stabilize loop regions and structural calcium-binding motifs in certain cutinases and thermophilic esterases.

properties.effect: Enhances thermal rigidity of cutinases; minimizes kinetic thermal inactivation at >60°C

name: Sodium Hydroxide Neutralizing Titrant (1 M NaOH)
description: Automated base titrant required in high-conversion bioreactor digests to neutralize terephthalic acid and MHET protons and maintain target pH.

properties.criticality: Essential in continuous or batch depolymerization >10% conversion to avoid self-limiting acidification and enzyme inactivation
